items.text: Monica Cooper is the elected City Treasurer of Carson, a position she has held since 2015. In her 2015 campaign, she stated she previously worked as an administrator for the state Franchise Tax Board. She is certified as a municipal treasurer and advanced investment manager. In 2016, the Fair Political Practices Commission fined her $4,000 for using her personal bank account to pay campaign expenses and for making prohibited expenditures in cash. At a May 2026 City Council meeting, she requested the reclassification of a position in her department, stating her budget could cover the cost without affecting the General Fund.
